一直到念到时笙的号，她才从那个姿势中回过神，起身进了房间。

房间坐着五个人，作为这次试镜的评委，中间的是导演，一个将近四十的男人，面容刚硬，不太好相处的模样。

导演叫宋韩，出了名的挑剔，据说曾经有个演员，一场戏，在他手上NG不下了百次，当然这只是个传闻，真的假的无从得知。

而他吹毛求疵的结果就是，捧红了不少艺人，有夸张的说法，在宋韩手中走一圈，演技地位直线上升。

“各位老师好，我是江晚。”时笙声音不轻不重，正好让在场的人都能听到，却又不会显得刺耳。

几位评委翻看了一下的江晚的资料，交头接耳一番，其中一人直接露出不看好的神情。

“自由发挥，开始。”宋韩板着脸喊开始。

时笙点点头，也不管其他四人，酝酿了下情绪进入表演。

她演的是女三白绾黑化，最重要的一场戏。

原主的演技不怎么样，时笙能借鉴的不多，她只能自行想象，将自己带入白绾，被人误解，没一个人相信她，她的世界充满了绝望和悲伤，在爱而不得的情况下，彻底沦为幕后BOSS的爪牙。

在场的人盯着场中的女子，他们似乎看到了那个绝望到极致，堕入黑暗的白绾。

直到时笙表演结束，房间陷入死一般的寂静.

三秒后，宋韩回神，看着时笙，吐字清晰的道:“你演得很好，回去等通知。”

其他四人各自对视了几眼，这意思就是定了？

之前的试镜的，这位除了喊开始，一个字都没吭的。

见此，其他四人纷纷说了几句场面话，态度明显比之前好了不少。

时笙按照规矩退出房间，唐隐立即上前，也没问她结果如何，直接带着她往外走，直到远离了人的视线，唐隐才慢条斯理的问，“结果如何？”

“等通知。”时笙耸耸肩，一脸的无所谓。

她知道宋韩开口，这个角色八九不离十，但是还没签约，她也就不慌告诉唐隐，免得有什么意外。

唐隐本来也没报多大的希望，听到这个答案，也没有露出失望的神色。

两人下楼的时候，唐隐接了个电话，挂了电话，唐隐脸色很难看，对着时笙道：“我先送你回去，今天没什么事，你在家休息。”

“你有事？”

唐隐抿了抿嘴角，算是默认了时笙的话。

“有事就去办吧，正好趁我还没大火前，我得享受一下平凡的生活。”

这妹子是有多自信，才确定自己一定能大火？

唐隐摇头，“我还是先送你回去。”作为经纪人，他哪里敢把自家艺人扔在大街上。

It wasn't until Shi Sheng's number was read that she came to her senses from that posture, stood up and entered the room.

There were five people sitting in the room, serving as judges for this audition. The one in the middle was the director, a man in his late forties with a tough face and a look that was not easy to get along with.

The director is Song Han, who is notoriously picky. It is said that there was once an actor who failed a scene no less than a hundred times. Of course, this is just a rumor, and there is no way to know whether it is true or not.

The result of his fault-finding is that many artists have become popular. There are exaggerated claims that after being in the hands of Song Han, his acting status will skyrocket.

"Hello teachers, I am Jiang Wan." Shi Sheng's voice was neither soft nor loud, just enough for everyone present to hear, but not harsh.

Several judges looked through Jiang Wan's information and whispered among themselves, and one of them showed a disapproving look.

"Let's play freely, let's begin." Song Han shouted with a straight face.

Shi Sheng nodded, ignoring the other four people, and worked up his emotions before entering the performance.

She played the most important scene in which the third female lead, Bai Wan, turns black.

The original protagonist's acting skills were not very good, and Shi Sheng had little to learn from. She could only imagine on her own, and brought herself into Bai Wan. She was misunderstood, and no one believed her. Her world was full of despair and sadness. Without love, she completely became a pawn of the boss behind the scenes.

The people present stared at the woman present, and they seemed to see Bai Wan who was extremely desperate and fell into darkness.

Until Shi Sheng's performance ended, the room fell into deathly silence.

Three seconds later, Song Han came back to his senses, looked at Shi Sheng, and said clearly: "You performed well, go back and wait for notification."

The other four people each looked at each other a few times. Does this mean it's settled?

In the previous audition, this person didn't say a word except shouting "start".

Seeing this, the other four people said a few words one after another, and their attitudes were obviously much better than before.

Shi Sheng followed the rules and exited the room. Tang Yin immediately stepped forward and took her out without asking her what the outcome was. Until she was out of sight, Tang Yin asked slowly, "What was the outcome?"

"Waiting for notification." Shi Sheng shrugged, looking indifferent.

She knew that Song Han was close to the role, but she hadn't signed the contract yet, so she didn't hesitate to tell Tang Yin to avoid any surprises.

Tang Yin didn't have much hope at first, but when he heard this answer, he didn't show any disappointment.

When the two of them went downstairs, Tang Yin answered the phone and hung up. Tang Yin looked ugly and said to Shi Sheng, "I'll take you back first. I have nothing to do today. You can rest at home."

"What's wrong with you?"

Tang Yin pursed his lips, acquiescing to Shi Sheng's words.

"Go and do it if you have something to do. Just before I get too angry, I have to enjoy an ordinary life."

How confident is this girl that she is sure that she will become famous?

Tang Yin shook his head, "I'd better send you back first." As a manager, how dare he throw his own artist on the street.
